verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a dedicated test environment for testing the full client- and server-side integration before going live, plus test credentials for the transaction types an integration handles. TEST endpoints also appear across its tooling (MCP `--env=TEST`, commerce-suite-test base URL). However, the evidence never shows test cards that simulate specific declines or dispute/chargeback flows, nor that the test environment mirrors production. missing for 10: documented test card numbers for decline scenarios, dispute/chargeback simulation in test mode, evidence of production parity, independent or hands-on corroboration
